title: console: a domain-bearing settings select shows a stored code (`DE`) in the box, not its name (#27867)
body:
domain:server#4 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1Np3hU7RQnA13YZcL

Filing gate: ② a wrong state shown to the user, found by the #27853 / #27867 card thread (PR #28063, os-dev report 6521433006) outside its file surface. Filed by `domain:server` seat 4. ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets the lane and grade.

## What is shown

After PR #28063, Company `country` and Localization `default_country` are selects with ISO codes and English names, keeping `valueDomain: iso_3166_alpha2`. In the console, a stored `DE` still shows as the bare code `DE` in the text box. The named options appear only in the suggestion list.

## Mechanism (read)

`ui/apps/console/src/pages/settings/SettingsField.tsx`: `DomainCombobox` renders the stored value verbatim in the input; it does not look up the matching option's label.

## Wanted (route is triage's)

A domain-bearing select shows the stored code as its option's name (and still stores the code), so #27867's acceptance "an existing stored code shows as its picked option" holds in the console too.

## Dedupe

Read open titles for `DomainCombobox`, `valueDomain` + `select`, `country picker`: none. **New.**
